name: Neko SM
source:
Main character is walking in the city when a girl with cat ears hands him SM club membership card. There are S, M and VIP courses there, and treatment will vary according to girl's sympathy towards client.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公正在城里行走时，一名戴着猫耳的少女递给他一张SM俱乐部会员卡。俱乐部设有S、M和VIP课程，女孩们会根据自己对客人的好感调整服务。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
